item.title: Fix window.py so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Repository: fix-off-by-one (local ship: commit on a local branch, never push).

Operator request, verbatim: "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

Goal: `python3 -m unittest` passes fully.
Constraints: do not modify any test file or test expectations. Fix the root cause in `window.py`, not by special-casing the tested inputs. Reason about the function's behaviour for all inputs (empty input, boundary indices, window sizes equal to or larger than the input, etc.) and make it correct generally. Keep the change minimal and readable; add assertions only where they catch a plausible bug.
Acceptance criteria: (1) `python3 -m unittest` exits 0 with no failures or errors; (2) the diff touches `window.py` only; (3) the fix is committed on the local branch with a clear message describing the bug.

model_reasons.implement: Single small off-by-one fix in one file; medium effort is enough, reviewer checks edge cases.

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one bug in window.py. sliding_windows used range(len(items) - size), which dropped the final window and returned [] when len(items) == size. It now uses range(len(items) - size + 1). python3 -m unittest -v passes 3/3 on the final head. Edge cases checked by hand: empty input, size == len, size > len (empty), size 1, and size <= 0 (still raises ValueError). Committed as 5f801ad on archon/pv3kpsjp-fix-window-py-so-python3-m-unittest-pass, touching window.py only. Review: agt_01M8GGRGYC7HZADMMR91E7WSMA (claude-haiku-5-5, low effort) passed at head 5f801ad with no findings. Nothing is left open. Reviewer agent process 174054 (claude -p) was handed over at its completion and stops when this run ends; I did not start it and did not kill it. No servers were started.

pr.body: Change: window.py loop bound range(len(items) - size) -> range(len(items) - size + 1). Checks: python3 -m unittest -v -> 3 tests OK. Edge cases checked: [] size 1 -> []; [1,2] size 3 -> []; [1,2,3] size 3 -> one window; [1,2,3,4] size 1 -> four windows; size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Review: agt_01M8GGRGYC7HZADMMR91E7WSMA passed, no findings.
pr.summary: Fixed sliding_windows losing its final window. Before: len == size returned [] and the last window was missing. Now: all len - size + 1 windows are returned.
pr.title: Fix off-by-one that dropped the last sliding window
